meta.limitations: Static railway geography, not a timetable, GPS feed, train coverage claim, or engineering survey. Named physical intercity corridors are not individual KTX, SRT, or ITX service patterns. Urban routes outside the Seoul layer have no live train data. Station membership near intercity corridors is approximate. OpenStreetMap coverage may be incomplete.
